result.summary: Several layout and overflow problems: category chips and restaurant cards are clipped, a restaurant name is truncated, and the last popular listing is cut off by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol…) is clipped on the right, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Give the horizontal carousel enough end padding or peek so the last card and its full title remain visible.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is cut off at the bottom by the tab bar, so the restaurant name, delivery info, and rating are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding/safe-area inset to the scroll content so cards sit fully above the tab bar.

issues.description: The cuisine category chips overflow the right edge (Healthy is clipped; another chip is only a sliver), so users cannot see all filters.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with clear overflow indication or wrap/fit chips within the screen.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated without an ellipsis or wrapping.
issues.suggestion: Allow two-line titles or add an ellipsis so names are not abruptly cut off.
